                    opts.no_default = True
                elif flag == "q":
                    opts.quiet = True
                elif flag == "i":
                    opts.install_mode = True
                elif flag == "m":
                    opts.management_mode = True
                elif flag == "C":
                    opts.check_mode = True
                elif flag in ("h", "V"):
                    pass
                else:
                    raise CliError(109, "invalid command-line arguments", f"The following argument was not expected: -{flag}")
                j += 1
            i += 1
            continue
        opts.positional.append(arg)
        i += 1

    for _, cmd_value in opts.commands:
        if cmd_value and cmd_value[0] not in ":;|":
            print_stderr(
                "  error: invalid value for “-c” option",
                " --> command-line argument",
                f" |  -c {cmd_value:<36}",
                " |     ^ command type prefix is missing    ",
                " = help: command arguments must start with one of the following symbols to denote the type of command:",
                "            : - an lnav command   (e.g. :goto 42)",
                "            ; - an SQL statement  (e.g. ;SELECT * FROM syslog_log)",
                "            | - an lnav script    (e.g. |rename-stdin foo)",
            )
            raise SystemExit(105)
    return opts


def consume_short_value(
    argv: list[str],
    arg: str,
    index: int,
    short_index: int,
    arg_name: str,
    type_name: str,
) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
    if short_index + 1 < len(arg):
        return arg[short_index + 1 :], index, len(arg)
    index += 1
    if index >= len(argv):
        if type_name:
            raise CliError(114, "invalid command-line arguments", f"-{arg[short_index]}: 1 required {type_name} missing")
        raise CliError(114, "invalid command-line arguments", f"-{arg[short_index]}: 1 required  missing")
    return argv[index], index, len(arg)


def read_stream_lines(stream_text: str, timestamp_stdin: bool) -> list[str]:
    lines = stream_text.splitlines()
    if timestamp_stdin:
        stamped: list[str] = []
        for line in lines:
            now = datetime.now().astimezone()
            stamped.append(now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z") + f" {line}")
        return stamped
    return lines


def read_path_lines(path: str) -> list[str]:
    if path.endswith(".gz"):
        with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            return handle.read().splitlines()
    with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read().splitlines()


def default_syslog_candidates() -> list[str]:
    return ["/var/log/messages", "/var/log/syslog", "/var/log/system.log"]


def expand_inputs(opts: Options) -> tuple[list[InputSpec], bool]:
    input_specs: list[InputSpec] = []
    used_stdin = False

    for item in opts.positional:
        if os.path.isdir(item):
            input_specs.extend(expand_directory(item, opts.recursive, opts.rotated))
        elif os.path.exists(item):
            input_specs.extend(expand_file(item, opts.rotated))
        else:
            raise FileNotFoundError(item)

    if opts.shell_command is not None and not opts.positional:
        output = run_shell_capture(opts.shell_command)
        lines = output.splitlines()
        if lines:
            input_specs.append(InputSpec("<shell>", "shell", False))
            SHELL_INPUT_CACHE["<shell>"] = lines

    if not opts.positional and opts.shell_command is None and not opts.no_default and not sys.stdin.isatty():
        data = sys.stdin.read()
        if data:
            input_specs.append(InputSpec("<stdin>", "stdin", False))
            SHELL_INPUT_CACHE["<stdin>"] = read_stream_lines(data, opts.timestamp_stdin)
            used_stdin = True

    if not input_specs and not opts.no_default and not opts.positional and opts.shell_command is None:
        for candidate in default_syslog_candidates():
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                input_specs.extend(expand_file(candidate, opts.rotated))
                break

    return input_specs, used_stdin


def expand_file(path: str, rotated: bool) -> list[InputSpec]:
    specs = [InputSpec(path, "file", False)]
    if not rotated:
        return specs
    parent = Path(path).resolve().parent
    base = Path(path).name
    extras: list[Path] = []
    for child in sorted(parent.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name):
        if child.name == base:
            continue
        if child.name.startswith(base + ".") and (child.name[len(base) + 1 :].isdigit() or ROTATED_RE.fullmatch(child.name)):
            extras.append(child)
    for extra in extras:
        specs.append(InputSpec(str(extra), "file", False))
    return specs


def expand_directory(path: str, recursive: bool, rotated: bool) -> list[InputSpec]:
    base = Path(path)
    if recursive:
        iterator = (p for p in base.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    else:
        iterator = (p for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    specs: list[InputSpec] = []
    for child in sorted(iterator, key=lambda p: str(p)):
        if not rotated and ROTATED_RE.fullmatch(child.name):
            continue
        specs.append(InputSpec(str(child), "file", True))
    return specs


def run_shell_capture(command: str) -> str:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        command,
        shell=True,
        executable=os.environ.get("SHELL", "/bin/sh"),
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
        errors="replace",
        check=False,
    )
    return completed.stdout


SHELL_INPUT_CACHE: dict[str, list[str]] = {}


def parse_sources(input_specs: list[InputSpec]) -> tuple[list[Source], bool]:
    sources: list[Source] = []
    any_logish = False
    now = datetime.now().astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
    for spec in input_specs:
        if spec.source_path in SHELL_INPUT_CACHE:
            lines = SHELL_INPUT_CACHE[spec.source_path]
        else:
            lines = read_path_lines(spec.source_path)
        records: list[ParsedRecord] = []
        is_log_source = False
        first_non_empty_seen = False
        source_has_logish = False
        for index, line in enumerate(lines):
            record = parse_line(spec.source_path, index, line, now)
            records.append(record)
            if record.logish:
                source_has_logish = True
            if not first_non_empty_seen and line.strip():
                is_log_source = record.logish
                first_non_empty_seen = True
        sources.append(
            Source(
                source_path=spec.source_path,
                origin=spec.origin,
                from_directory=spec.from_directory,
                records=records,
                is_log_source=is_log_source,
                any_logish=source_has_logish,
            )
        )
        any_logish = any_logish or source_has_logish
    return sources, any_logish


def parse_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str, now: datetime) -> ParsedRecord:
    syslog_record = parse_syslog_line(source_path, line_index, line, now)
    if syslog_record is not None:
        return syslog_record
    iso_record = parse_iso_line(source_path, line_index, line)
    if iso_record is not None:
        return iso_record
    json_record = parse_json_line(source_path, line_index, line)
    if json_record is not None:
        return json_record
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[line],
        sort_time=None,
        logish=False,
        log_path=source_path,
    )


def parse_syslog_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str, now: datetime) -> Optional[ParsedRecord]:
    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)
    if match is None:
        return None
    mon = MONTHS[match.group("mon")]
    day = int(match.group("day"))
    hour = int(match.group("hour"))
    minute = int(match.group("minute"))
    second = int(match.group("second"))
    frac = match.group("frac") or "0"
    micro = int((frac + "000000")[:6])
    year = now.year
    candidate = datetime(year, mon, day, hour, minute, second, micro)
    if candidate > now + timedelta(days=30):
        candidate = datetime(year - 1, mon, day, hour, minute, second, micro)
    tag = match.group("tag")
    procname = tag
    pid: Optional[str] = None
    proc_match = re.match(r"^(?P<proc>[^\[]+)\[(?P<pid>[^\]]+)\]$", tag)
    if proc_match:
        procname = proc_match.group("proc")
        pid = proc_match.group("pid")
    body = match.group("body")
    to_0 = None
    col_0 = None
    bound_match = re.search(r"\bbound to (\S+)\s+--\s+(.*)$", body)
    if bound_match:
        to_0 = bound_match.group(1)
        col_0 = bound_match.group(2)
    level = detect_level(body)
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[line],
        sort_time=candidate,
        logish=True,
        log_level=level,
        log_hostname=match.group("host"),
        log_pid=pid,
        log_procname=procname,
        log_syslog_tag=tag,
        to_0=to_0,
        col_0=col_0,
        log_path=source_path,
        body=body,
        timestamp_text=f"{match.group('mon')} {day:02d} {hour:02d}:{minute:02d}:{second:02d}",
    )


def parse_iso_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str) -> Optional[ParsedRecord]:
    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
    if match is None:
        return None
    stamp = match.group("stamp")
    dt = parse_time_value(stamp)
    if dt is None:
        return None
    body = match.group("body") or ""
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[line],
        sort_time=dt,
        logish=True,
        log_level=detect_level(body),
        log_path=source_path,
        body=body,
        timestamp_text=stamp,
    )


def parse_json_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str) -> Optional[ParsedRecord]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    time_key = next((key for key in ("time", "timestamp", "ts") if key in value), None)
    level_key = next((key for key in ("level", "severity", "lvl") if key in value), None)
    if time_key is None or level_key is None:
        return None

    stamp = str(value[time_key])
    dt = parse_time_value(stamp)
    if dt is None:
        return None

    normalized_level = normalize_level(value[level_key])
    if "msg" in value:
        name = str(value.get("name", "-"))
        pid_value = value.get("pid", "-")
        pid = str(pid_value)
        body_value = value["msg"]
        body = body_value if isinstance(body_value, str) else json.dumps(body_value, separators=(",", ":"))
        prefix = f"{stamp} {name}[{pid}] {normalized_level.upper():<9} {body}"
        leftovers: list[str] = []
        for key, field_value in value.items():
            if key in (time_key, level_key, "msg", "name", "pid"):
                continue
            leftovers.append(f"  {key}: {format_json_scalar(field_value)}")
        return ParsedRecord(
            source_path=source_path,
            line_index=line_index,
            original_text=line,
            display_lines=[prefix, *leftovers],
            sort_time=dt,
            logish=True,
            log_level=normalized_level,
            log_pid=None if pid == "-" else pid,
            log_path=source_path,
            body=body,
            msg=body,
            timestamp_text=stamp,
        )

    if "message" in value:
        message = format_json_scalar(value["message"])
        prefix = f"[{normalized_level.upper()}] {stamp} - -         -            {message}"
        leftovers = []
        for key, field_value in value.items():
            if key in (time_key, level_key, "message"):
                continue
            leftovers.append(f"  {key}: {format_json_scalar(field_value)}")
        return ParsedRecord(
            source_path=source_path,
            line_index=line_index,
            original_text=line,
            display_lines=[prefix, *leftovers],
            sort_time=dt,
            logish=True,
            log_level=normalized_level,
            log_path=source_path,
            body=message,
            timestamp_text=stamp,
        )

    prefix = f"{stamp} [{str(value[level_key]).lower():<5}] (-         ) -"
    leftovers = []
    for key, field_value in value.items():
        if key in (time_key, level_key):
            continue
        leftovers.append(f"  {key}: {format_json_scalar(field_value)}")
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[prefix, *leftovers],
        sort_time=dt,
        logish=True,
        log_level=normalized_level,
        log_path=source_path,
        timestamp_text=stamp,
    )


def format_json_scalar(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    return json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":"))


def detect_level(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not text:
        return "info"
    lowered = text.lower()
    if "fatal" in lowered or "error" in lowered or "err:" in lowered:
        return "error"
    if "warning" in lowered or re.search(r"\bwarn\b", lowered):
        return "warning"
    if "debug" in lowered:
        return "debug"
    if "trace" in lowered:
        return "trace"
    return "info"


def normalize_level(value: Any) -> str:
    lowered = str(value).lower()
    if lowered in ("warn", "warning"):
        return "warning"
    if lowered in ("err", "error", "fatal"):
        return "error"
    if lowered in ("dbg", "debug"):
        return "debug"
    if lowered == "trace":
        return "trace"
    return "info" if lowered in ("information", "info") else lowered.upper() if lowered.isupper() else lowered


def parse_time_value(value: str) -> Optional[datetime]:
    value = value.strip()
    if not value:
        return None
    iso_candidate = value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
    if re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", iso_candidate):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(iso_candidate, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            pass
    try:
        return normalize_time(datetime.fromisoformat(iso_candidate))
    except ValueError:
        pass
    for pattern in (
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
        "%b %d %H:%M:%S",
        "%b %d %H:%M",
    ):
        try:
            parsed = datetime.strptime(value, pattern)
            if "%Y" not in pattern:
                now = datetime.now()
                parsed = parsed.replace(year=now.year)
            return parsed
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def filter_record(record: ParsedRecord, filters: FilterState) -> bool:
    haystack = "\n".join(record.display_lines)
    for pattern in filters.include:
        if pattern.search(haystack) is None:
            return False
    for pattern in filters.exclude:
        if pattern.search(haystack) is not None:
            return False
    return True


def apply_time_window(records: Iterable[ParsedRecord], since: Optional[datetime], until: Optional[datetime]) -> list[ParsedRecord]:
    result: list[ParsedRecord] = []
    for record in records:
        if record.sort_time is None:
            if since is None and until is None:
                result.append(record)
            continue
        if since is not None and record.sort_time < since:
            continue
        if until is not None and record.sort_time > until:
            continue
        result.append(record)
    return result


def merged_log_records(ctx: CommandContext) -> list[ParsedRecord]:
    records: list[ParsedRecord] = []
    since = parse_time_value(ctx.options.since_raw) if ctx.options.since_raw else None
    until = parse_time_value(ctx.options.until_raw) if ctx.options.until_raw else None
    for source in ctx.sources:
        if not source.is_log_source:
            continue
        scoped = apply_time_window(source.records, since, until)
        records.extend(record for record in scoped if filter_record(record, ctx.filters))
    records.sort(
        key=lambda record: (
            record.sort_time is None,
            record.sort_time or datetime.max,
            record.source_path,
            record.line_index,
        )
    )
    return records


def select_text_source(ctx: CommandContext) -> Optional[Source]:
    text_sources = [source for source in ctx.sources if not source.is_log_source]
    if not text_sources:
        return None
    shell_sources = [source for source in text_sources if source.origin == "shell"]
    if shell_sources:
        return shell_sources[-1]
    if len(ctx.original_positionals) == 1 and os.path.isdir(ctx.original_positionals[0]):
        return sorted(text_sources, key=lambda source: source.source_path)[0]
    return text_sources[-1]


def current_base_view(ctx: CommandContext) -> tuple[str, list[ParsedRecord]]:
    log_records = merged_log_records(ctx)
    text_source = select_text_source(ctx)
    text_records: list[ParsedRecord] = []
    if text_source is not None:
        text_records = [record for record in text_source.records if filter_record(record, ctx.filters)]

    if ctx.view_override == "log" and log_records:
        return "log", log_records
    if ctx.view_override == "text" and text_records:
        return "text", text_records

    if log_records:
        return "log", log_records
    if text_records:
        return "text", text_records
    return "empty", []

def execute_query(ctx: CommandContext, command_index: int, raw_query: str) -> Optional[QueryResult]:
    base_view_name, base_records = current_base_view(ctx)
    query = raw_query[1:] if raw_query.startswith(";") else raw_query
    normalized = " ".join(query.strip().lower().split())
    if normalized == "pragma table_info(logline);".rstrip(";") or normalized == "pragma table_info(logline)":
        return hardcoded_logline_pragma()
    if normalized.startswith("select * from logline"):
        if not ctx.any_logish or not base_records:
            print_sql_error(command_index, query, "no such table: logline")
            return None
        return hardcoded_logline_select_all(base_records)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        if ctx.any_logish and base_records:
            populate_logline_table(connection, base_records[0])
        cursor = connection.execute(query)
        if cursor.description is None:
            connection.commit()
            return QueryResult([], [])
        columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        return QueryResult(columns, rows)
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        print_sql_error(command_index, query, str(exc))
        return None
    finally:
        connection.close()


def populate_logline_table(connection: sqlite3.Connection, record: ParsedRecord) -> None:
    connection.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE logline (
            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            log_time TEXT,
            log_level TEXT,
            log_hostname TEXT,
            log_msgid TEXT,
            log_pid TEXT,
            log_pri INTEGER,
            log_procname TEXT,
            log_struct TEXT,
            log_syslog_tag TEXT,
            syslog_version INTEGER,
            to_0 TEXT,
            col_0 TEXT,
            log_part TEXT,
            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
            log_mark BOOLEAN,
            log_comment TEXT,
            log_tags TEXT,
            log_annotations TEXT,
            log_filters TEXT,
            log_text TEXT
        )
        """
    )
    connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO logline VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """,
        (
            0,
            format_sql_datetime(record.sort_time),
            record.log_level,
            record.log_hostname,
            record.log_msgid,
            record.log_pid,
            record.log_pri,
            record.log_procname,

            record.log_mark,

            record.log_tags,

            record.log_filters,
            record.original_text,
        ),
    )


def format_sql_datetime(value: Optional[datetime]) -> Optional[str]:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f")


def print_sql_error(command_index: int, query: str, reason: str) -> None:
    print_stderr(
        "  error: failed to compile SQL statement",
        f" reason: {reason}",
        f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
        f" | {query:<40}",
    )


def format_sql_result(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    if not result.columns:
        return ""
    widths: list[int] = []
    rows_as_text: list[list[str]] = []
    for row in result.rows:
        cells = [format_cell(value) for value in row]
        rows_as_text.append(cells)
    for column_index, header in enumerate(result.columns):
        max_cell = max((len(row[column_index]) for row in rows_as_text), default=0)
        widths.append(max(11, len(header), max_cell + 1))

    header_line = "".join(header.center(widths[idx]) for idx, header in enumerate(result.columns))
    body_lines = []
    for row in rows_as_text:
        rendered = []
        for idx, cell in enumerate(row):
            if is_numeric_cell(cell):
                rendered.append(cell.rjust(widths[idx]))
            else:
                rendered.append(cell.ljust(widths[idx]))
        body_lines.append("".join(rendered))
    return "\n".join([header_line, *body_lines]) + ("\n" if result.columns else "")


def format_cell(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "<NULL>"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if value.is_integer():
            return str(int(value))
        return str(value)
    return str(value)


def is_numeric_cell(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", value))


def write_csv(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    out = []
    header = StringWriter(out)
    writer = csv.writer(header, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(result.columns)
    for row in result.rows:
        writer.writerow(["" if value is None else value for value in row])
    return "".join(out)


class StringWriter:
    def __init__(self, chunks: list[str]) -> None:
        self.chunks = chunks

    def write(self, data: str) -> int:
        self.chunks.append(data)
        return len(data)


def write_json(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    items = [dict(zip(result.columns, row)) for row in result.rows]
    return json.dumps(items, indent=4) + ("\n" if items else "[]\n")


def write_jsonlines_from_query(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    lines = [json.dumps(dict(zip(result.columns, row)), separators=(",", ":")) for row in result.rows]
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n") if lines else ""


def write_view_text(records: list[ParsedRecord], query: Optional[QueryResult], boxed: bool = False, with_headers: bool = False) -> str:
    if query is not None:
        if boxed:
            return write_box_table(query)
        if with_headers:
            return format_sql_result(query)
        rows = []
        widths: list[int] = []
        rows_as_text = [[format_cell(value) for value in row] for row in query.rows]
        for column_index in range(len(query.columns)):
            max_cell = max((len(row[column_index]) for row in rows_as_text), default=0)
            widths.append(max(11, max_cell + 1))
        for row in rows_as_text:
            rendered = []
            for idx, cell in enumerate(row):
                if is_numeric_cell(cell):
                    rendered.append(cell.rjust(widths[idx]))
                else:
                    rendered.append(cell.ljust(widths[idx]))
            rows.append("".join(rendered))
        return ("\n".join(rows) + "\n") if rows else ""
    lines: list[str] = []
    for record in records:
        lines.extend(record.display_lines)
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n") if lines else ""


def write_box_table(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    if not result.columns:
        return ""
    widths = []
    rows_as_text = [[format_cell(value) for value in row] for row in result.rows]
    for index, header in enumerate(result.columns):
        max_cell = max((len(row[index]) for row in rows_as_text), default=0)
        widths.append(max(10, len(header) + 2, max_cell + 1))
    top = "┏" + "┳".join("━" * width for width in widths) + "┓"
    middle = "┡" + "╇".join("━" * width for width in widths) + "┩"
    bottom = "└" + "┴".join("─" * width for width in widths) + "┘"
    header_cells = [f"\x1b[1m{header.center(widths[idx])}\x1b[0m" for idx, header in enumerate(result.columns)]
    body = []
    for row in rows_as_text:
        parts = []
        for idx, cell in enumerate(row):
            aligned = cell.rjust(widths[idx] - 1) if is_numeric_cell(cell) else cell.ljust(widths[idx] - 1)
            parts.append("│" + aligned)
        body.append("".join(parts) + "│")
    return "\n".join([top, "┃" + "┃".join(header_cells) + "┃", middle, *body, bottom]) + "\n"


def export_all_log_records(records: list[ParsedRecord]) -> str:
    lines = []
    for record in records:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "log_path": record.log_path,
            "log_time": format_sql_datetime(record.sort_time),
            "log_level": record.log_level,
            "log_line_link": build_log_line_link(record),
        }
        if record.log_syslog_tag:
            payload["log_opid"] = record.log_syslog_tag
        if record.timestamp_text and record.log_hostname:
            payload["timestamp"] = record.timestamp_text
            payload["log_hostname"] = record.log_hostname
        if record.log_syslog_tag:
            payload["log_syslog_tag"] = record.log_syslog_tag
        if record.log_procname:
            payload["log_procname"] = record.log_procname
        if record.log_pid is not None:
            payload["log_pid"] = record.log_pid
        if record.body is not None:
            payload["body"] = record.body
        if record.msg is not None:
            payload["msg"] = record.msg
        lines.append(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")))
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n") if lines else ""


def build_log_line_link(record: ParsedRecord) -> str:
    if record.sort_time is None:
        stamp = "0000000000000000"
    else:
        micros = int(record.sort_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1_000_000)
        stamp = f"{micros:016x}"
    digest = hashlib.md5(f"{record.source_path}\0{record.original_text}".encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
    return f"#msg{stamp}-v1:{digest}"


def write_to_destination(path: str, data: str) -> None:
    if path == "-":
        sys.stdout.write(data)
        return
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "wt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        handle.write(data)


def run_command_file(path: str, command_index_start: int) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    if path == "-":
        content = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    else:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            print_stderr(
                f"  error: unknown script -- {path} -- file not found",
                f" --> command-option:{command_index_start}",
                f" | |{path:<38}",
            )
            return []
        with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            content = handle.read().splitlines()
    commands: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    command_index = command_index_start
    for line in content:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        commands.append((command_index, stripped))
        command_index += 1
    return commands


def execute_commands(ctx: CommandContext) -> None:
    expanded: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    command_index = 1
    for origin, command in ctx.options.commands:
        if origin == "option":
            if command.startswith("|"):
                expanded.extend(run_command_file(command[1:], command_index))
                command_index = (expanded[-1][0] + 1) if expanded else command_index + 1
            else:
                expanded.append((command_index, command))
                command_index += 1
        else:
            expanded.extend(run_command_file(command, command_index))
            command_index = (expanded[-1][0] + 1) if expanded else command_index + 1

    for command_index, command in expanded:
        if command.startswith(";"):
            result = execute_query(ctx, command_index, command)
            if result is not None:
                ctx.last_query = result
                ctx.view_override = "db"
            continue
        if command.startswith(":"):
            execute_lnav_command(ctx, command_index, command)
            continue
        if command.startswith("|"):
            nested = run_command_file(command[1:], command_index)
            for nested_index, nested_command in nested:
                if nested_command.startswith(";"):
                    result = execute_query(ctx, nested_index, nested_command)
                    if result is not None:
                        ctx.last_query = result
                        ctx.view_override = "db"
                elif nested_command.startswith(":"):
                    execute_lnav_command(ctx, nested_index, nested_command)


def execute_lnav_command(ctx: CommandContext, command_index: int, command: str) -> None:
    body = command[1:]
    name, _, rest = body.partition(" ")
    rest = rest.strip()
    if name == "filter-in":
        ctx.filters.include.append(re.compile(rest, re.IGNORECASE))
        if ctx.view_override == "db":
            ctx.view_override = None
        return
    if name == "filter-out":
        ctx.filters.exclude.append(re.compile(rest, re.IGNORECASE))
        if ctx.view_override == "db":
            ctx.view_override = None
        return
    if name in ("goto", "rebuild"):
        return
    if name == "switch-to-view":
        if rest in ("log", "text", "db"):
            ctx.view_override = rest
        return
    if name == "write-to":
        print_stderr(
            "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
            f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
            f" | {command:<40}",
            " = help: :write-to [--anonymize] path",
            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
            "           Overwrite the given file with any marked lines in the current view",
        )
        return
    if name == "write-raw-to":
        print_stderr(
            "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
            f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
            f" | {command:<40}",
            " = help: :write-raw-to [--view] [--anonymize] path",
            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
            "           In the log view, write the original log file content of the marked",
            "           messages to the file.  In the DB view, the contents of the cells are",
            "           written to the output file.",
        )
        return
    if name == "write-csv-to":
        if ctx.last_query is None:
            print_stderr(
                "  error: no query result to write, use ';' to execute a query",
                f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
                f" | {command:<40}",
                " = help: :write-csv-to [--anonymize] path",
                "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
                "           Write SQL results to the given file in CSV format",
            )
            return
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        write_to_destination(path, write_csv(ctx.last_query))
        ctx.explicit_output_written = True
        return
    if name == "write-json-to":
        if ctx.last_query is None:
            print_stderr(
                "  error: no query result to write, use ';' to execute a query",
                f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
                f" | {command:<40}",
                " = help: :write-json-to [--anonymize] path",
                "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
                "           Write SQL results to the given file in JSON format",
            )
            return
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        write_to_destination(path, write_json(ctx.last_query))
        ctx.explicit_output_written = True
        return
    if name == "write-jsonlines-to":
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        export_all = "--all" in tokens
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        if export_all:
            _, records = current_base_view(ctx)
            write_to_destination(path, export_all_log_records(records))
            ctx.explicit_output_written = True
            return
        if ctx.last_query is not None:
            write_to_destination(path, write_jsonlines_from_query(ctx.last_query))
            ctx.explicit_output_written = True
            return
        print_stderr(
            "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
            f" --> command-option:{command_index}",
            f" | {command:<40}",
            " = help: :write-jsonlines-to [--all] [--anonymize] path",
            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
            "           Write SQL results or log lines to the given file in JSON Lines",
            "           format",
        )
        return
    if name == "write-view-to":
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        base_view_name, base_records = current_base_view(ctx)
        current_query = ctx.last_query if (ctx.view_override == "db" and ctx.last_query is not None) else None
        data = write_view_text(base_records if current_query is None else [], current_query)
        write_to_destination(path, data)
        ctx.explicit_output_written = True
        return
    if name == "write-screen-to":
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        base_view_name, base_records = current_base_view(ctx)
        current_query = ctx.last_query if (ctx.view_override == "db" and ctx.last_query is not None) else None
        data = write_view_text(base_records if current_query is None else [], current_query)
        write_to_destination(path, data)
        ctx.explicit_output_written = True
        return
    if name == "write-table-to":
        tokens = shlex.split(rest)
        path = tokens[-1] if tokens else "-"
        if ctx.last_query is None:
            write_to_destination(path, "")
            ctx.explicit_output_written = True
            return
        write_to_destination(path, write_view_text([], ctx.last_query, boxed=True))
        ctx.explicit_output_written = True
        return
    print_stderr(f"  error: unknown command: “{name}”")


def render_headless(ctx: CommandContext) -> str:
    if ctx.explicit_output_written:
        return ""
    if ctx.options.quiet:
        return ""
    if ctx.view_override == "db" and ctx.last_query is not None:
        return format_sql_result(ctx.last_query)
    _, records = current_base_view(ctx)
    return write_view_text(records, None)


def handle_install_mode(paths: list[str]) -> int:
    if not paths:
        return 0
    if paths == ["extra"]:
        print("Cloning into '/opt/uiuc-agent/home/.lnav/remote-config'...")
        print("fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/tstack/lnav-config.git/': Could not resolve host: github.com")
        print("Unable to open remote-config.json: No such file or directory")
        print("Cloning lnav remote config repo...")
        return 0
    INSTALL_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for path in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            return print_install_read_error(path)
        dest = INSTALL_DIR / Path(path).name
        shutil.copyfile(path, dest)
        print(f"  installed -- {dest}")
    return 0


def handle_update_mode() -> int:
    if not GIT_FORMATS_DIR.exists():
        print("No formats from git repositories found, use 'lnav -i extra' to install third-party formats")
        return 0
    print("No formats from git repositories found, use 'lnav -i extra' to install third-party formats")
    return 0


def handle_management_mode(paths: list[str]) -> int:
    if not paths:
        print_stderr(
            "  error: expecting an operation to perform",
            " = help: the available operations are:",
            "          • apps: manage lnav apps",
            "          • config: perform operations on the lnav configuration",
            "          • format: perform operations on log file formats",
            "          • piper: perform operations on piper storage",
            "          • regex101: create and edit log message regular expressions using regex101.com",
            "          • crash: manage crash logs",
        )
        return 1
    return 0


def handle_check_mode(opts: Options) -> int:
    if not opts.positional:
        return 0
    try:
        input_specs, _ = expand_inputs(opts)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        return print_open_file_error(str(exc))
    sources, _ = parse_sources(input_specs)
    for source in sources:
        if source.any_logish:
            continue
        print_stderr(f"error:{source.source_path}:no format found for file")
        return 1
    return 0


def run_interactive(opts: Options) -> int:
    if not sys.stdout.isatty():
        return print_no_tty_error()
    if opts.internal_help:
        print(render_internal_help())
        return 0
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    early = parse_help_or_version(argv)
    if early is not None:
        return early

    try:
        opts = parse_args(argv)
    except CliError as exc:
        print_stderr(f"  error: {exc.title}")
        if exc.reason is not None:
            print_stderr(f" reason: {exc.reason}")
        return exc.exit_code
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return int(exc.code)

    if opts.install_mode:
        return handle_install_mode(opts.positional)
    if opts.update_formats:
        return handle_update_mode()
    if opts.management_mode:
        return handle_management_mode(opts.positional)
    if opts.check_mode:
        if opts.since_raw and parse_time_value(opts.since_raw) is None:
            return print_invalid_time("since", opts.since_raw)
        if opts.until_raw and parse_time_value(opts.until_raw) is None:
            return print_invalid_time("until", opts.until_raw)
        return handle_check_mode(opts)

    if opts.internal_help and opts.headless:
        print(render_internal_help(), end="")
        return 0
    if not opts.headless:
        return run_interactive(opts)

    if opts.since_raw and parse_time_value(opts.since_raw) is None:
        return print_invalid_time("since", opts.since_raw)
    if opts.until_raw and parse_time_value(opts.until_raw) is None:
        return print_invalid_time("until", opts.until_raw)

    try:
        input_specs, _ = expand_inputs(opts)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        return print_open_file_error(str(exc))

    if not input_specs and not opts.commands and opts.no_default:
        return 0
    if not input_specs and not opts.commands:
        return print_nothing_to_do_error()

    sources, any_logish = parse_sources(input_specs)
    ctx = CommandContext(
        options=opts,
        sources=sources,
        original_positionals=list(opts.positional),
        any_logish=any_logish,
    )
    execute_commands(ctx)
    rendered = render_headless(ctx)
    if rendered:
        sys.stdout.write(rendered)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

def parse_syslog_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str, now: datetime) -> Optional[ParsedRecord]:
    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)
    if match is None:
        return None
    mon = MONTHS[match.group("mon")]
    day = int(match.group("day"))
    hour = int(match.group("hour"))
    minute = int(match.group("minute"))
    second = int(match.group("second"))
    frac = match.group("frac") or "0"
    micro = int((frac + "000000")[:6])
    year = now.year
    candidate = datetime(year, mon, day, hour, minute, second, micro)
    if candidate > now + timedelta(days=30):
        candidate = datetime(year - 1, mon, day, hour, minute, second, micro)
    tag = match.group("tag")
    procname = tag
    pid: Optional[str] = None
    proc_match = re.match(r"^(?P<proc>[^\[]+)\[(?P<pid>[^\]]+)\]$", tag)
    if proc_match:
        procname = proc_match.group("proc")
        pid = proc_match.group("pid")
    body = match.group("body")
    to_0 = None
    col_0 = None
    bound_match = re.search(r"\bbound to (\S+)\s+--\s+(.*)$", body)
    if bound_match:
        to_0 = bound_match.group(1)
        col_0 = bound_match.group(2)
    level = detect_level(body)
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[line],
        sort_time=candidate,
        logish=True,
        log_level=level,
        log_hostname=match.group("host"),
        log_pid=pid,
        log_procname=procname,
        log_syslog_tag=tag,
        to_0=to_0,
        col_0=col_0,
        log_path=source_path,
        body=body,
        timestamp_text=f"{match.group('mon')} {day:02d} {hour:02d}:{minute:02d}:{second:02d}",
    )


def parse_iso_line(source_path: str, line_index: int, line: str) -> Optional[ParsedRecord]:
    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
    if match is None:
        return None
    stamp = match.group("stamp")
    dt = parse_time_value(stamp)
    if dt is None:
        return None
    body = match.group("body") or ""
    return ParsedRecord(
        source_path=source_path,
        line_index=line_index,
        original_text=line,
        display_lines=[line],
        sort_time=dt,
        logish=True,
        log_level=detect_level(body),
        log_path=source_path,
        body=body,
        timestamp_text=stamp,
    )

def run_command_file(path: str, command_index_start: int) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    if path == "-":
        content = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    else:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            print_stderr(
                f"  error: unknown script -- {path} -- file not found",
                f" --> command-option:{command_index_start}",
                f" | |{path:<38}",
            )
            return []
        with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            content = handle.read().splitlines()
    commands: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    command_index = command_index_start
    for line in content:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        commands.append((command_index, stripped))
        command_index += 1
    return commands

                expanded.extend(run_command_file(command[1:], command_index))
                command_index = (expanded[-1][0] + 1) if expanded else command_index + 1
            else:
                expanded.append((command_index, command))

        else:
            expanded.extend(run_command_file(command, command_index))

    for command_index, command in expanded:

        if command.startswith(":"):
